about: Chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway since 1970, widely regarded as the most successful long-term value investor of the 20th and early 21st centuries. Already covered in the book library via Buffett: The Making of an American Capitalist and Charlie Munger: The Complete Investor.

quotes.text: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
Our favorite holding period is forever.
Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget Rule No. 1.
quotes.source: Widely attributed in interviews; exact origin debated

quotes.text: It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
quotes.source: Widely attributed; consistent with his long-documented public remarks

relatedIds.label: Buffett: The Making of an American Capitalist
